senses.en_definition: A weapon with a long, sharp blade, usually tapering to a point; a sword.

messages.en: Have you seen the sword in the upstairs gallery? The engraving on it is absolutely gorgeous.
Yeah! I wanted to get a closer look, but we're not allowed to touch it, right?

senses.en_definition: To care about, take notice of, or pay attention to someone or something.
To involve oneself in or interfere in other people's affairs.

collocations.en: take an interest in other people's affairs
meddle in other people's private affairs

messages.en: Someone said my presentation earlier was terrible. I'm feeling pretty down.
Don't worry so much about what they say. You did your best.

senses.en_definition: To hold, grip, or grasp with the hand; to catch or seize someone.
To possess, carry, or use something, such as a weapon or an identity document.
To control, run, or manage something; to hold a position or fulfil a role.
To obey or observe rules or orders; to uphold principles or keep a promise; to accept something as trustworthy or true.
In folk belief, to possess a person or take control of their body, as a ghost or evil spirit.

messages.en: I'll hold the rope on this side. Can you hold the other end?
Sure. Hold on tight, okay? Don't let go until the wardrobe is down on the floor.

senses.en_definition: An official or staff member holding a position in a government department, institution, or company.
A military officer of the rank of second lieutenant or above, or a police officer of the rank of inspector or above.

messages.en: Sis, what do I put in this section? I'm at counter three now.
Ask the officer there first. If you're not sure, leave it blank for now. I'm looking for a photocopy of my ID card in my bag.
